name: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell

instructions.description: Sit with the forearm supported on a bench and palm facing down.
Let the hand move freely beyond the edge.
Lift the back of the hand through a small comfortable range.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Wrist Extension with Dumbbell — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Wrist Extension with Dumbbell — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a light load and a small controlled range.
